title: OpenAI Codex CLI
summary: A terminal-native agentic coding system that enables autonomous software engineering through local repository access, multimodal inputs, and multi-agent orchestration. It represents the 2025 evolution of the original Codex model, shifting from simple code completion to proactive, tool-supported task execution.
research_notes: The ecosystem now includes 'Codex Security' for automated vulnerability patching and integrated support across VS Code, Cursor, and Xcode.

evolution.summary: After being deprecated in 2023, Codex was rebooted in April 2025 as a CLI-centric platform. It transitioned to a Rust-based architecture with support for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and is currently powered by the GPT-5 model series, featuring native computer-use capabilities.
